scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi.json --output src/lib/api/schema.d.ts && bun scripts/requires.ts && bun scripts/limits.ts && paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/lib/paraglide --strategy localStorage preferredLanguage baseLocale
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun --bun vite build
scripts.check: bun run generate && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.shots: bun run build && playwright test --config playwright.shots.config.ts
